g.text: What changes at each hop, and what does not
IP addresses = where it is going (stays). MAC addresses = who gets it next (changes).
src MAC: PC dst MAC: Router
src MAC: Router dst MAC: ISP
NAT rewrote the source IP here
src MAC: ISP dst MAC: Core
Home router = NAT: source 192.168.1.10 becomes the public 203.45.67.89 (and the source port is translated too). Without NAT the IP header would stay
